BLOCKING for T10 and for N-RC-10: the canonical literal frozen here names a nine-argument signature that exists in no artifact at this base, so it MUST be reconciled against the INTEGRATED Stage-A authority before any of these controls may be reported PASS, and a divergence STOPS the lane rather than being silently absorbed.

postgres_requirements.rationale: Every control in this amendment is a question about what a REAL pg_catalog returns for a specific signature string, and none of them can be answered by a mock. T10 and N-RC-10 require a catalog that holds first the seven-argument completion verb (OLD_DB) and then, with the seven-argument form DROPPED, the nine-argument one (NEW_DB), so that the same frozen literal can be observed resolving FALSE and then TRUE. N-RC-10-B additionally requires the mutant literal to be observed returning NULL in the SAME NEW_DB state as the canonical literal returns non-NULL, because only a same-state comparison attributes the divergence to the mutated token. Always via pnpm db:audit:disposable against a fresh throwaway container, destroyed afterwards; never staging, never production, never the canonical local Supabase stack. Both manifest paths are UNKNOWN because they remain pre-implementation commitments. NOTE ON THE SUBSTRATE, measured while authoring this amendment on supabase/postgres:17.6.1.143: the postgres role is NOT a superuser on that image and cannot create the uellix_stella_ops schema; the proof was taken as supabase_admin. A harness that assumes postgres is superuser will die in SETUP, and a setup failure must be asserted as SETUP=SUCCESS rather than inferred from probe colour.

positive_controls.description: Canonical probe literal identity. DELTA CONTROL added by this amendment. Two obligations. (a) IDENTITY: the fixed literal in the production probe is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the canonical literal frozen at docs/ops/wave3/FIBDB053_RUNTIME_COMPANION_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json SECTION_A3.CANONICAL_PROBE_LITERAL.value, namely: uellix_stella_ops.complete_operation_ticket(character,uuid,character,character varying,character varying,integer,jsonb,character varying,text[]) -- asserted against that frozen string, never by re-deriving the literal from the implementation. (b) RESOLUTION: against a real catalog, that same literal resolves to exactly the OID of the installed nine-argument uellix_stella_ops.complete_operation_ticket in the NEW_DB state, and to NULL in the OLD_DB state where only the seven-argument form exists. This control is what makes the FIXED LITERAL rule auditable: the parent authority literal_rule is retained and NOT weakened by the amendment, but its justification is corrected -- a fixed literal is required because it is the only form that can be compared against the Stage-A declaration and given to N-RC-10 as a single frozen comparand, not because a rival spelling would resolve differently. FUTURE-DEPENDENT: requires a disposable container and blocked by N-RC-09 until the nine-argument signature exists in an integrated Stage-A authority.

negative_controls.description: Probe signature identity. RE-SCOPED BY THIS AMENDMENT; supersedes the base manifest N-RC-10, whose description inherited the parent authority false grapheme premise and instructed this control to assert only that the probe returns TRUE against a catalog holding the nine-argument function -- an assertion the declared grapheme mutant ALSO satisfies, which is why the base pairing was vacuous. The correct hazard is SEMANTIC SIGNATURE IDENTITY, not textual alias spelling. Against ONE real catalog in the NEW_DB state (nine-argument signature installed, seven-argument signature dropped), this control must prove all THREE arms. N-RC-10-A: to_regprocedure(<canonical literal>) IS NOT NULL is TRUE. N-RC-10-B: to_regprocedure(<the exact MUT-RC-12 mutant literal, sixth argument bigint instead of integer>) IS NOT NULL is FALSE. This is the load-bearing arm: A and B differ in exactly one token, asserted in the SAME catalog state, so a divergence in the verdict can only be attributed to that token. N-RC-10-C: to_regprocedure(<the pg_catalog grapheme>) resolves to the SAME OID as to_regprocedure(<canonical literal>). This is the VACUITY GUARD -- it pins the measured fact that alternate spellings are interchangeable, so a future lane cannot reintroduce the withdrawn grapheme mutation as if it were load-bearing. It goes RED only if a future PostgreSQL stops normalizing type aliases, which would itself be a finding rather than a test failure. Both literals must be asserted as FROZEN STRINGS. A naked "the probe works" assertion is INVALID. Catches MUT-RC-12.

Re-probe cardinality. DELTA CONTROL added by this amendment to make an EXISTING binding rule falsifiable: the parent authority CATALOG_PROBE_CONTRACT.invalidation_and_reprobe.bounded_once_rule requires exactly one re-probe and at most one retry, with no loop, no second invalidation and no backoff ladder. The refresh audit found no control proving that cardinality, and it is re-derived here that none of the base manifest 31 controls counts probe invocations -- T5 is about idempotent replay and T7 about probe inversion after rollback. This amendment does NOT alter the rule; it only makes it testable. Obligation: drive a completion that returns SQLSTATE 42883 and COUNT the catalog round-trips the bridge issues, using a PER-CALL invocation delta on the real probe path -- an incremented counter or a spy whose call count is read before and after -- never a boolean "did it re-probe" and never a mock that stands in for the module under test. Required assertions, all on the same driven failure: exactly ONE re-probe after the 42883; AT MOST ONE retry, and that retry in a NEW transaction (the same-transaction fallback is separately prohibited by P-1 and caught by MUT-RC-04 exhibiting 25P02); and, when the re-probe yields the same state, termination in the wrapper existing FAIL CLOSED outcome with NO further probe. The control must also assert that the driven 42883 actually reached the bridge (SETUP=SUCCESS), because a setup that fails before the completion call produces zero probes and would satisfy a naive cardinality assertion vacuously. Catches MUT-RC-13. FUTURE-DEPENDENT: no bridge module exists at this base.

mutation_controls.description: RE-SCOPED BY THIS AMENDMENT; supersedes the base manifest MUT-RC-12, whose mutation was "write the probe literal in the pg_catalog grapheme instead of the to_regprocedure input grapheme". Measured on a real PostgreSQL 17.6 catalog, that mutant resolves to the SAME OID as the original, so it is not a mutation at all and the pairing was vacuous. NEW MUTATION: change the SIXTH argument type of the probe literal from integer to bigint, leaving the schema, the function name, the argument order, the arity and every other token byte-unchanged. The mutant literal is: uellix_stella_ops.complete_operation_ticket(character,uuid,character,character varying,character varying,bigint,jsonb,character varying,text[]) -- one token from the canonical. It is syntactically valid (MEASURED: to_regprocedure accepts it, returns NULL, raises no SQLSTATE and leaves psql exit code 0) and genuinely wrong (integer/int4 and bigint/int8 are different types, not two spellings of one). It is non-obvious rather than a typo: integer to bigint IS an implicit cast that ordinary function-call resolution applies, but to_regprocedure does exact type matching and does not apply it. It FAILS SILENT in the only measurable sense -- the probe query reports nothing wrong and the bridge pins itself to OLD_DB on a NEW_DB database. FORBIDDEN RE-EXPRESSION: this mutation must never be restated as an alternate spelling of the SAME type; every such spelling resolves identically and would reinstate the vacuity this amendment removes. Must be caught by N-RC-10, specifically arm N-RC-10-B.

DELTA CONTROL added by this amendment. Three mutants of the parent bounded_once_rule, each applied alone to the bridge invalidation path, each of which must drive N-RC-11 RED. (a) SECOND RE-PROBE: after the single permitted re-probe, invalidate and probe once more before deciding. (b) RETRY LOOP: replace the at-most-one retry with a bounded or unbounded loop that re-probes on each iteration. (c) BACKOFF LADDER: insert a delay ladder between re-probes, re-probing after each delay. Each is a deliberate breakage of a rule the parent freezes verbatim and that this amendment does not alter. NON-VACUITY REQUIREMENT: N-RC-11 must go RED for each mutant individually on a per-call invocation delta, not merely for the three combined, and not by re-expressing the cardinality predicate inside the mutation battery itself -- a battery that restates its control predicate proves only that the copy goes red. Must be caught by N-RC-11.
